unsure.why: No dialogue line, letter, or event that starts this bounty is in these files. The original game's bounties start when you travel into a hold, but this hold-by-hold copy has no start of its own on record, so how you are handed it (a jarl or steward, an innkeeper's rumour, or a courier's letter, which the quest has slots for) can't be confirmed.
The place is picked by the game when the bounty starts, from the Pale; the rules for which places qualify aren't in these files.
The records show a gold reward but not the amount. The original game's version of this bounty also hands out an item from Requiem's reward list; that list isn't attached to this copy in the records.
The quest has two hand-in objectives, one for the steward and one for the jarl; which one the game shows you isn't in these files.
The jarl and steward are whoever holds the Pale at the time, which can change during the civil war; the records place the court at the White Hall in Dawnstar.
